description: This file defines a static class 'MessagingProcessingInstruments' that manages various metrics and counters related to messaging processing within the Orleans runtime. It initializes counters for message processing, reception, forwarding, and enqueuing, and provides methods to update these metrics based on message events.

classes.name: MessagingProcessingInstruments
classes.description: A static class responsible for defining and updating messaging-related performance metrics within Orleans.

methods.name: MessagingProcessingInstruments
methods.description: Static constructor that initializes various counters and aggregators for messaging metrics.

methods.name: OnDispatcherMessageReceive
methods.description: Updates counters when a message is received.

methods.name: OnDispatcherMessageProcessedOk
methods.description: Updates counters when a message is processed successfully.

methods.name: OnDispatcherMessageProcessedError
methods.description: Updates counters when message processing results in an error.

methods.name: OnDispatcherMessageForwared
methods.description: Updates counters when a message is forwarded.

methods.name: OnImaMessageReceived
methods.description: Updates counters when an IMA message is received.

methods.name: OnImaMessageEnqueued
methods.description: Updates counters when an IMA message is enqueued, based on the context type.

methods.name: RegisterActivationDataAllObserve
methods.description: Registers an observable gauge for activation data metrics.
